'''Dagmar Vozda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] agent who worked for the [[Office of the Auditor-General]]. Vozda was responsible for recruiting [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] into the ranks of the Authority after she aided Vozda in apprehending fugitive [[holostar]] [[Rex Shaxrigge]]. After Vozda retired, Fiolla took her position.
